quotes.text: Neither the federal nor the state government can arrange these decisions behind closed doors and force them onto local communities. If I become your representative in Congress, I'll make sure that stays the same.
quotes.editor_note: Gazette (Janesville) candidate Q&A (Jul. 28, 2026) on data-center development. His mechanism is keeping siting decisions open to local communities rather than centralized/closed-door — contrasts with Pocan's developer-pays-infrastructure-costs mechanism on the same question. Verbatim, no edits.

quotes.text: The best way Congress can affect our cost of living is to balance the budget, then start slowly bringing down the debt.
quotes.editor_note: Same Gazette Q&A (Jul. 28, 2026), answering a cost-of-living question by tying it to the federal tax-and-spending balance — a cleaner, more current statement of his fiscal position than the flat-tax line already live for this topic. Offered as a second draft for the taxes topic. Verbatim, no edits.
